data.long_meaning: Ekansh is a Sanskrit name that originates from the word 'Ek' meaning 'One' and 'Ansh' meaning 'Step'. This name signifies taking a single, bold step towards achieving one's goals. The name Ekansh carries the meaning “Single Step, One Step” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ekansh usually hope their child will grow to embody single step, one step and live with faith, good character and purpose.
